season.summary: NOAA has an El Niño Advisory in effect, with a better than 83% chance of a strong to very strong El Niño through January to March 2027. NOAA's winter outlook favors a warmer than average December to February for the Pacific Northwest, with no clear lean on precipitation. El Niño winters usually mean less snowpack here, though the very strong events of 1982-83 and 2015-16 were wetter than normal across much of the Northwest.
